scope.description: Two transfer attempts on separate four-member clusters with one demoted member each: an automatic LeadershipTransfer() control on a cluster whose demoted member is a follower, and an explicit LeadershipTransferToServer for that demoted member on an identical cluster.
assumptions: The demoted member is chosen at the moment of demotion so it is a follower, because demoting the sitting leader starts a transfer of its own.
Each case bootstraps its own cluster, so the two cases share no state.
The harness waits up to two seconds for the demoted member's own GetConfiguration to report the non-voter role before transferring, and records whether that convergence happened.
A transfer future is awaited for at most five seconds per attempt and at most five attempts are made, retrying only while the error names a transfer already in progress.
excluded: No assertion about data safety or about entries applied during the transfer; the probe records the outcome of one client write after the watch window.
The five-member cluster and the non-converged demotion race are covered by other receipts and are not repeated here.
Failover time and vote counts are sampled every ten milliseconds, so an interval shorter than that can be missed.

basis.prefix: Each case bootstraps a four-peer cluster with the in-memory transport and waits for a leader, demotes one non-leader member with DemoteVoter, and polls that member's GetConfiguration until its own view reports the non-voter role. A case event records the mode, the demoted member, its role view, convergence time and the leader before the transfer. The control calls LeadershipTransfer() and the trigger calls LeadershipTransferToServer(targetID, targetAddress); each future is awaited on its own goroutine for at most five seconds, and while the error names a transfer already in progress the harness retries, up to five attempts, recording every attempt's error. A result event records the future outcome, per-attempt errors, whether the target ever reported Leader during a three-second sample, the leaderless sample count, the final leader and whether it is a voter, then submits one client Apply and one GetConfiguration to the current leader and records their errors.
basis.responsibility: LeadershipTransferToServer accepts a caller-named member and is documented as transferring leadership to that server; the library, not the caller, owns the target check and the transfer bookkeeping. On a configuration in which the named member has no vote, the same library already skips such members when it chooses a target itself, so the explicit entry point is the only path that can admit a target that cannot win, and it must either refuse that target or install it.

comparisons.description: The automatic transfer on a cluster that contains a demoted member must complete without error; a false witness contradicts it.
If an explicit transfer to a configured member is admitted rather than refused for having no vote, that member must become leader; a false witness contradicts it.

knowledge.assertion: pickServer skips servers whose suffrage is not Voter, while an explicit id is looked up in leaderState.replState, which contains non-voters, and proceeds to replicate and send TimeoutNow.
A voter receiving a RequestVote from a configured non-voter adopts a higher term and steps down before rejecting the vote, and timeoutNow performs no membership check.
